backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a chat backend with user registration, profile management, contacts, and conversations, using role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the ProfileSetupModal fix (registerUser flow and chat layout transition) to relevant frontend files and test ID REQ-13.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing their roles in the chat app UI and recent bug fixes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining light and dark OKLCH CSS custom properties for the app's color system and base body styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TSX entry point as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that gates rendering between LoginScreen, ProfileSetupModal, and ChatLayout based on authentication and profile query state, with a loading splash screen.
frontend/src/components/ChatLayout.tsx: Three-panel responsive chat layout managing active conversation, sidebar navigation, message panel, and an optional info panel.
frontend/src/components/ContactsScreen.t: Contacts management screen allowing users to add contacts by principal ID, search existing contacts, and initiate conversations.
frontend/src/components/ConversationSide: Renders the left sidebar with a list of conversations, search input, and header actions (new group, contacts, profile). Filters conversations by search term and supports opening a NewGroupModal.
frontend/src/components/InfoPanel.tsx: Displays a right-side info panel for the active conversation, showing contact or group details, member list, and conversation stats.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Renders the unauthenticated landing screen with Internet Identity login, featuring app branding, feature highlights, and a login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.ts: Renders a single chat message bubble with sender avatar, name (for groups), timestamp, and read/delivered status icon.
frontend/src/components/MessageInput.tsx: Provides a textarea and send button for composing and submitting messages, supporting Enter-to-send and auto-resizing height.
frontend/src/components/MessagePanel.tsx: Displays the main chat view for a selected conversation, including the header with contact/group info, scrollable message list, and the message input component.
frontend/src/components/MessageStatusIco: Small icon component that renders a teal double-checkmark for read messages or a muted double-checkmark for delivered messages.
frontend/src/components/NewGroupModal.ts: Modal dialog for creating a new group conversation, allowing the user to enter a group name and select contacts via checkboxes before submitting.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSettingsS: Screen for viewing and editing the current user's display name and avatar URL, with save and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Initial profile setup form shown to newly authenticated users, collecting a display name and optional avatar URL to register their account.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthFlow.ts: Hook that combines authentication state and user profile loading to determine whether to show the profile setup modal and whether the app is ready to render.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity React context and hook for managing authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profile CRUD, conversation management, messaging, and contacts.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Inter font, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines dark-first OKLCH color tokens for the chat UI including sidebar, messages, and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to extract URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers for sensitive values like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH-based color tokens, Inter font, custom chat/sidebar/teal color palettes, border radii, shadows, and fade/accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking version, existing features, known issues (unresponsive create profile screen), and architectural notes for a WhatsApp-like messaging app built on Internet Identity.
